gloss: to become absorbed; to be engrossed

definitions.gloss: to become absorbed in; to be engrossed in
definitions.explanation: To become so focused on or fascinated by something that one loses awareness of everything else.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{夢中|むちゅう}になる。
{子|こ}どもたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{砂|すな}{遊|あそ}び→砂遊び：18964_sunaasobi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{夢中|むちゅう}になって⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The children were engrossed in playing in the sand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{読書|どくしょ}→読書：03484_dokusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{夢中|むちゅう}になって、⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{過|す}ごして→乗り過ごす：07928_norisugosu⟧しまった。
examples.english: I got so absorbed in reading that I missed my train stop.

notes:
The pattern is ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{夢中|むちゅう}になる, where ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ marks the object of fascination. The literal meaning of ⟦{夢中|むちゅう}→夢中：03752_muchuu⟧ is "in a dream": so absorbed that the rest of the world fades away.

ASPECT (ている):
{夢中|むちゅう}になって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes the ongoing state of being absorbed: ⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{夢中|むちゅう}になって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (is hooked on games right now). It can also describe being infatuated with a person: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{夢中|むちゅう}になって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (is crazy about her).

WATCH OUT:
The adverbial ⟦{夢中|むちゅう}→夢中：03752_muchuu⟧で is different: it means doing something desperately or without thinking, not being fascinated. ⟦{夢中|むちゅう}→夢中：03752_muchuu⟧で⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ means "I ran for my life" or "I ran without thinking," not "I enjoyed running."
